description: This file defines the 'FilePut' interface, specifying methods for adding single or multiple files related to content management in a merchant store context.

classes.name: FilePut
classes.description: Interface for content file upload operations, providing methods to add individual or multiple files for a given merchant store.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single content file for a specified merchant store, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple content files for a specified merchant store, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
